Package dev.px.core.render

Class Color

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.render.Color
public final class Color extends Object
Immutable packed ARGB colour.

Core defines its own instead of using java.awt.Color so nothing in the render path drags AWT in, and so a colour can be handed to a NanoVG, Skija, or OpenGL backend without conversion at every call site.

Instances are cheap and escape-analysis friendly; treat them as values.
